description.narrative: ADF is a grant mechanism supporting the Asian Development Bank’s ADB’s poorest members, including nine Pacific Island countries. Australia pushed to increase the share of ADF that goes into our region, and our advocacy achieved significant grants and technical assistance to vulnerable Pacific Island countries. Australia was the second largest donor to ADF13 through the replenishment of the Asian Development Fund (ADF). Australia’s own contribution of AUD423 million demonstrates our commitment to supporting the region’s most vulnerable in partnership with ADB as an institution with finance and expertise at scale.
